hooks.command: command -v kit-subscribe >/dev/null 2>&1 && KSUB=kit-subscribe || { C="${ORISO_KIT_HOME:-$HOME/.oriso-dev-kit}/kit-subscribe.sh"; [ -f "$C" ] || C="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/understand-kit/kit-subscribe.sh"; if [ -f "$C" ]; then KSUB="bash $C"; else KSUB=""; fi; }; if [ -n "$KSUB" ]; then $KSUB --max-seconds 10 2>&1 | tail -1; else echo "[kit-subscribe] not installed — skipping"; fi; exit 0

command -v ua-pull >/dev/null 2>&1 && UAP=ua-pull || UAP="${ORISO_KIT_HOME:-$HOME/.oriso-dev-kit}/ua-pull.sh"; [ -e "$UAP" ] || UAP="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/understand-kit/ua-pull.sh"; [ -x "$UAP" ] || UAP="bash $UAP"; if $UAP --verify >/tmp/ua-pull-verify.$$ 2>&1; then echo "[ua-pull] knowledge graph fresh"; else tail -c 400 /tmp/ua-pull-verify.$$ | tail -1; if [ -n "${ORISO_UA_BASE:-}" ]; then $UAP --via-https "$ORISO_UA_BASE" >/tmp/ua-pull-run.$$ 2>&1; else $UAP --via-ssh >/tmp/ua-pull-run.$$ 2>&1; fi; tail -1 /tmp/ua-pull-run.$$; fi; rm -f /tmp/ua-pull-verify.$$ /tmp/ua-pull-run.$$
